title: The Teddy Wilson CBS show and album; resuming on January 29, 1973
summary: Hinton plays a track from the Teddy Wilson, Jo Jones and Milt Hinton album from the CBS television show and resumes in the 1950s.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Just take a break and relax for a bit. Hey, Jo, I'm going to play some Teddy Wilson, Jo Jones, and Milt Hinton. Can't remember what year we did this in but we were doing a television show at CBS called "On a Saturday Afternoon", called the Teddy Wilson Hour and then we made an album with it for Norman Granz. Let's listen to some of that.
That was beautiful. That was the first side of that Teddy Wilson, Jo Jones, and Milt Hinton. When did we make that, Jo, I've forgotten?

Jo, just as a record, we've been spending a good deal of time here, the few times we've been here. Now it's January 29th, 1973. We're still going on this thing but we're up to the 50's. You said those records made with Teddy Wilson were about in the 50's, huh?
So what did you do after - I remember we stayed in the Embers there till practically they closed it. I went with somebody to go some place. Joe Bushkin left.
I remember we stayed in the Embers there for a while with Joe Bushkin.
